public_rationale: Oracle's corporate funding plan complicates the assertion that the projects depend entirely on their own cash flows. It does not, however, identify the financing and repayment terms of every referenced campus. Nor does Oracle's broader customer base prove that another customer could replace OpenAI for this revenue. The two exclusive assertions remain unestablished.
limitations: Funding sources and ultimate repayment sources are different questions.
Existing tenants do not establish whether replacement customers are commercially feasible.
The financial-structure claim has no specified accounting basis.

Use the latest reported Oracle fiscal quarter before the post, December 2025 through February 2026, for the ongoing financial state.

The words specify no accounting basis for this financial-structure assertion; record unknown rather than assigning one.
